Tests MUST assert against shell truth (real subshell cwd), not current output -- both families survived existing tests because the tests encoded the implementation.

/session-start Step 0 decides 'merged' with `git merge-base --is-ancestor $head origin/main`. A squash merge writes a new single-parent commit, so the branch tip is never an ancestor -- the predicate is really 'was this merged with a merge commit?', not 'is this work on main?'. Five worktrees were flagged UNMERGED at session start; all five were fully merged 2026-07-30 with content verified byte-identical on main. 0% precision on that population. Because Step 0 correctly refuses to auto-remove a FLAGGED worktree, each false flag recurs every session indefinitely, and a flag that is wrong every time it fires trains the reader to dismiss the one genuinely stranded worktree (the #339 failure mode). Ancestry is also wrong for rebase-merge and cherry-pick, so the fix must be content-based, not squash-special-cased. Safety direction is the constraint that decides the review: Step 0 AUTO-REMOVES anything classified merged, so a false 'merged' silently deletes unmerged work -- the classifier must be strictly non-relaxing and every failure path must degrade to not-merged. Sibling of #1177 (prevention). Must preserve #839 (Step 0 block stays statically analyzable: no process substitution, no here-strings) and must not weaken no_worktree_self_delete (#173/#535).
